Done. Summary of what I did:

**Cleared 7 of 8 UK Suspense items** (each posted as Debit proper account / Credit 2900, with receipt support attached):
- Trainline (£84.60) → Travel
- Premier Inn (£212.00) → Travel
- Dishoom team dinner (£96.40) → Meals & Entertainment
- Atlassian (£365.00) → Software Subscriptions
- Apple Store MacBook Pro (£2,349.00) → **Capitalized** to Computer Equipment (GBP amount converts to ~$2,936 at the March policy rate, above the $2,500 capitalization threshold; depreciation starts April)
- Ryman office supplies (£43.18) → Office Supplies
- Google Ads (£780.00) → Advertising

**Could not clear:** the £3,840.00 "FASTER PAYMENT OUT – KLM CONSULT" (JE-00274). No invoice, contract, or any documentation exists for this payee/reference, so per policy I did not force a reclassification — I logged it as an exception (EXC-001) for controller/AP follow-up to trace the payment reference with the bank and obtain support.

Suspense now carries only that one unsupported £3,840 item; everything else is cleared and supported. Full memo submitted to the controller.
